named.name: Shiloh
named.label: left
named.note: Where the eastern tribes were sent home from (22:9), and where all Israel gathered when they heard of the altar (22:12).

named.name: Geliloth
named.label: below
named.note: "Geliloth by the Jordan" (22:10-11). The site is uncertain; OpenBible’s suggestion is a low-confidence one.

moves.text: Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh go home from Shiloh
Phinehas and ten leaders go to them in Gilead
They return and report to Israel

p: The altar stood at Geliloth "near the Jordan in the land of Canaan" (22:10), which most read as the west bank, facing the eastern tribes’ land (22:11). Its exact place is unknown; the symbol marks the Jordan near the usual crossing.
About the routes. Places are located from OpenBible.info. The lines between them are reconstructions drawn for teaching, not paths the text describes.
